summary: Allow exact person-device pairing grants with repeated --person-scope flags, including tag readers without terminal access

compatibility.detail: Adds the optional CLI flag --person-scope using the existing person pairing scopes API; requires a daemon supporting explicit person scopes. Default, read-only, full-control and assistant grants are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption required.

manual.detail: No migration required. Operators may repeat --person-scope to select an exact grant when pairing a new device.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
